description: This file contains functions for parsing Chinese hanzi-pinyin pairs, handling fill-in-the-blank challenges with HTML content, including ruby annotations and plain text, for use in a language learning application.

methods.name: parseHanziPinyinPairs
methods.description: Parses all hanzi-pinyin pairs from a given text string.

methods.name: parseAnswer
methods.description: Parses a text to extract a single hanzi-pinyin pair or returns the original text.

methods.name: parseBlanks
methods.description: Parses a paragraph of HTML content to identify and process blanks and ruby annotations for Chinese characters and pinyin.
